purpose: Establish Collector provenance, raw event timestamp semantics, cursor/revision/late-arrival behavior, source payload location and outcome exposure before any immutable event snapshot or BTC candidate formula is designed.
inventory_tasks: Fix ZIP and internal file SHA256 values.
Record Collector status, cycles, failures, interval and cursor progression.
Identify raw alert identifier, raw payload location and storage path.
Identify collection/receipt timestamp and its clock domain.
Determine duplicate, revision, replacement and late-arrival behavior.
Determine the meaning of genuine source event time before M7C normalization.
Identify whether Collector storage exposes outcome-like or post-event fields.
Check whether the logs explain or corroborate the 2026-07-23 M7C process restart without resetting prospective start.
Determine whether an exact minimal read-only SQLite/database snapshot is required for D1 completion.
Return unresolved questions before D2 snapshot, event ledger or candidate grammar is implemented.
stop_conditions: Collector or M7C abnormal status is detected.
Exact source provenance or clock domain cannot be established from allowed evidence.
A required source artifact is missing or internally inconsistent.
Stable entry, latest handoff, current state or next action conflict.
user_action: Upload one ZIP containing collector_forever.log, latest_loop_status.json and latest_collection_result.json. Do not stop, restart or edit Collector/M7C.
